content: 1. For patients weighing 15–24 kg, administer 3 mg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. 2. For patients weighing 25–35 kg, administer 6 mg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. 3. For patients weighing 36–50 kg, administer 9 mg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. 4. For patients weighing 51–65 kg, administer 12 mg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. 5. For patients weighing 66–79 kg, administer 15 mg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. 6. For patients weighing more than 80 kg, administer 200 mcg/kg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. Repeat Dosing Guidelines: For patients weighing 15–25 kg, administer 3 mg of ivermectin orally and consider repeating the dose in 3–12 months if necessary. For patients weighing 26–44 kg, administer 6 mg of ivermectin orally and consider repeating the dose in 3–12 months if necessary. For patients weighing 45–64 kg, administer 9 mg of ivermectin orally and consider repeating the dose in 3–12 months if necessary. For patients weighing 65–84 kg, administer 12 mg of ivermectin orally and consider repeating the dose in 3–12 months if necessary. For patients weighing ≥85 kg, administer 150 mcg/kg of ivermectin orally and consider repeating the dose in 3–12 months if necessary. Special Dosing Instructions: Administer 200 mcg/kg of ivermectin orally as a single dose, and if additional doses are required, repeat after 7 days. For immunocompromised patients, administer 200 mcg/kg of ivermectin orally as a single dose and repeat in 14 days if necessary. For gnathostomiasis, administer 200 mcg/kg of ivermectin orally as a single dose. Administration Instructions: Ivermectin should be taken on an empty stomach. Monitor stool examinations for Strongyloides infections. Safety Considerations: For patients weighing less than 15 kg, the safety and efficacy of ivermectin have not been established. Drug Interactions: Erdafitinib: Increases ivermectin levels via P-glycoprotein (P-gp) inhibition. Avoid coadministration or use an alternative drug. If unavoidable, separate administration by at least 6 hours before or after P-gp substrates with a narrow therapeutic index. Lasmiditan: Increases ivermectin levels via P-gp inhibition.
